description: test_chat_request_rejects_short_question takes the first element of a set of greetings
notes: unordered collection: the question is next(iter({'hi', 'hello'})). Set iteration order of strings depends on per-process hash randomization (PYTHONHASHSEED unset), so roughly half the processes pick 'hello' (5 chars, valid) and pytest.raises reports DID NOT RAISE.
